name: Suzetta Gallina
summary: At the Gallina Winery in Stormwind City, Suzetta Gallina tends her family's wine trade.

sections.title: A Taste of the Canals
sections.body: Along Stormwind's Canals, Suzetta Gallina helps run the Gallina Winery. Its shelves hold wines brought from across the kingdom and wines made there. The family supplies taverns, nobles, and common folk. Her work keeps the capital's trade moving through troubled times.

faq.answer: Suzetta Gallina belongs to the family that runs the Gallina Winery along Stormwind City's Canals.

faq.q: Where can I find Suzetta Gallina?
faq.answer: Find Suzetta inside the Gallina Winery, along the canals between the Trade District and Cathedral Square in Stormwind City.

faq.q: Does Suzetta offer any work for travelers?
faq.answer: Suzetta does not offer work directly. Her brother Renato gives out Wine Tickets. Bring one to her at the Gallina Winery to receive a complimentary bottle of the family's special pinot noir.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler returning from the dangers of Elwynn or Westfall, a stop at Suzetta's shop offers a glimpse of peaceful life in the capital.
